definition: a working test indexed to my own map, with absolute truth as the limit it never reaches

settled:
Net compression of my conceptual map is indexed to my map. It is not the same thing as absolute truth, and I do not run the two together.

My map is my best understanding of absolute truth at the moment. I believe the two are the same in the limit, but that limit is infinitely far away.

So there are two claims here rather than a contradiction. The working test is the one I can actually operate. The absolute is the thing the map converges toward and never arrives at.

Improving myself is what moves the map along that line: each later map a net more compressed account than the one before it.

title: How Far My Map Is From The Truth
